title: Technovation: Why Good Companies Go Bad
summary: Peter High is president of Metis Strategy and hosts the Technovation podcast. Eric joined him for episode 1063, where the two treated organizations as 'superorganisms' with collective intelligence and moral character.
blockquote: Eric argues that corporate corruption rarely begins with bad actors. Instead, it emerges from organizational design — governance structures, incentives, and metrics that gradually push companies away from their original mission.
